title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir
description: Normal high school kids by day, protectors of Paris by night! Miraculous follows the heroic adventures of Marinette and Adrien as they transform into Ladybug and Cat Noir and set out to capture akumas, creatures responsible for turning the people of Paris into villains. But neither hero knows the other’s true identity – or that they’re classmates!

episodes.title: S3-E25Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous – Part 1)
S3-E26Miracle Queen (The Battle of the Miraculous – Part 2)

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 1x1
episodes_data.description: After losing a contest for TV weather girl, bitter Aurore is akumatized into the villain Stormy Weather, who traps Marinette's friend Alya in ice.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 1x2
episodes_data.description: Adrien's best friend, Nino, is akumatized into the Bubbler, a villain who traps adults in bubbles and sends them floating away into the atmosphere.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 1x3
episodes_data.description: When a villain with the power of the ancient Egyptian gods wants to sacrifice Alya, Ladybug and Cat Noir must fight an army of mummies to rescue her.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 1x4
episodes_data.description: Mistakenly believing that Chloé is Ladybug, Alya gets expelled from school for her nosiness and becomes akumatized into the villain Lady Wifi.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 1x5
episodes_data.description: When anger over a broken watch turns Alix into a time-traveling villain, it's up to Ladybug to return to the past and thwart her plans.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 1x6
episodes_data.description: The akuma fighters try to apprehend Mr. Pigeon, a bird lover who has kidnapped all the park keepers in Paris, but Cat Noir's allergies interfere.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 1x7
episodes_data.description: A fellow student with a crush on Marinette is akumatized into the Evillustrator, a villain that Cat Noir must face without Ladybug.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 1x8
episodes_data.description: When he's fired by the mayor, police officer Roger becomes Rogercop, a villain who thinks he's enforcing the law by ruling Paris as a dictator.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 1x9
episodes_data.description: A jealous sculptor in love with Ladybug akumatizes into Copycat, a duplicate of Cat Noir who tries to take his rival's place by Ladybug's side.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 1x10
episodes_data.description: Marinette considers declaring her feelings to Adrien for Valentine's Day, but first they must stop Dark Cupid, a villain bent on eradicating love.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 1x11
episodes_data.description: During the filming of a short horror movie for Marinette's class, scared star Mylène is akumatized into a slimy monster that feeds on others' fears.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 1x12
episodes_data.description: While Marinette tries to retrieve her diary from Chloé, Adrien's fencing teacher is akumatized into Darkblade, a villain who storms city hall.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 1x13
episodes_data.description: When Mylène's father loses a part in a play to his scheming understudy, he akumatizes into the Mime, a villain whose pantomimes become real.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 1x14
episodes_data.description: When his dish at a competition is sabotaged, Marinette's great-uncle chef Wang Cheng becomes Kung Food, who recruits henchmen with his cooking.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 1x15
episodes_data.description: Marinette beats Adrien's video game tournament partner, Max, so she can replace him and spend time with her crush, but Max akumatizes into a villain.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 1x16
episodes_data.description: A humiliated zookeeper is akumatized into a villainous shapeshifting animal on a day when Marinette, Adrien and friends are visiting the zoo in Paris.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 1x17
episodes_data.description: Crestfallen when her hero Ladybug refuses to heed her advice, Chloé akumatizes into Antibug, an evil twin of Ladybug with identical powers.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 1x18
episodes_data.description: Marinette babysits little Manon, who becomes akumatized into the Puppeteer while playing with dolls of Ladybug, Cat Noir and some infamous villains.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 1x19
episodes_data.description: Excluded from a class photo, dejected Juleka akumatizes into the villain Reflekta, who turns everyone, including Cat Noir, into copies of herself.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 1x20
episodes_data.description: Rock star Jagged Stone is akumatized into a supervillain who tries to transform all Parisians into fans and undermine his musical rival, Mr. XY.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 1x21
episodes_data.description: Rejected by a rock star, an angry fan becomes Pixelator, who traps Parisians in his camera's memory until Cat Noir and Ladybug halt his photo spree.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 1x22
episodes_data.description: Marinette can't transform into Ladybug when classmate Rose is akumatized into a villain whose perfume lets her control Cat Noir and a visiting prince.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 1x23
episodes_data.description: A hypnotist akumatizes into Simon Says, a villain who can make anyone obey him with his deck of cards, and seeks revenge on Adrien's father.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 1x24
episodes_data.description: Humiliated in front of Adrien by Marinette, Lila -- a rival who pretends to be Ladybug's friend -- akumatizes into Volpina, a villain of illusions.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 1x25
episodes_data.description: In a flashback, Ladybug and Cat Noir's origins are revealed, as Marinette befriends Alya and meets Adrien, a famous model with an overprotective dad.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 1x26
episodes_data.description: In a continuing flashback to Ladybug and Cat Noir's origins, Marinette mistakes Adrien for a bully and hesitates to embrace her Ladybug persona.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 2x1
episodes_data.description: Master Fu and Marinette believe that the owner of the Miraculous book is Hawk Moth, but that suspicion leads to either Adrien or his father, Gabriel.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 2x2
episodes_data.description: Trying to learn how to be nice, Chloé throws a party but loses her temper and fires her butler, who becomes akumatized into the vengeful Despair Bear.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 2x3
episodes_data.description: During an exclusive interview, a reporter trying to trap Ladybug and Cat Noir into confessing feelings for each other is akumatized by Hawk Moth.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 2x4
episodes_data.description: When Marinette elects to hang out with her friends on her birthday instead of her grandmother, grandma is akumatized into a candy-gun-wielding baddie.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 2x5
episodes_data.description: A fencing opponent who loses a duel against Adrien gets akumatized and goes after him for a rematch while only Ladybug is around to protect him.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 2x6
episodes_data.description: Hawk Moth akumatizes Max's best friend and pet robot, Markov, into Robostus, a raging techno-threat with the power to bring inanimate objects to life.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 2x7
episodes_data.description: Marinette's plans to ask Adrien out on a romantic walk are foiled when Hawk Moth akumatizes a frustrated child into a giant, lollipop-seeking baby.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 2x8
episodes_data.description: After school principal Damocles is akumatized into Dark Owl, he traps Ladybug and Cat Noir in a warehouse and tries to uncover their true identities.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 2x9
episodes_data.description: Marinette meets Alya and friends for a treat at André's, a legendary Parisian ice cream maker, but André is akumatized into the villain Glaciator.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 2x10
episodes_data.description: During a sleepover with Marinette, Alya punishes her twin sisters, Etta and Ella, who get akumatized into monsters that multiply when they eat.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 2x11
episodes_data.description: Marinette must rescue Adrien from a group of overzealous fans and from his own bodyguard, who has been akumatized into the hulking Gorizilla.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 2x12
episodes_data.description: Hawk Moth akumatizes Juleka's mother into Captain Hardrock, a pirate whose indestructible ship blasts loud music to destroy a music festival.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 2x13
episodes_data.description: The students give gifts to Miss Bustier on her birthday but the popular teacher is akumatized into Zombizou, a monster armed with evil black lipstick.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 2x14
episodes_data.description: When her crush, Kim, goes on a movie date with someone else, talented swimmer Ondine gets akumatized into Syren, who tries to submerge Paris.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 2x15
episodes_data.description: Marinette is cast to play Ladybug and Adrien as Cat Noir for a music video honoring the heroes, but the star gets akumatized into a musical monster.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 2x16
episodes_data.description: A rock star is scheduled to visit the bakery owned by Marinette's parents, but his overwhelmed personal assistant is akumatized by Hawk Moth.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 2x17
episodes_data.description: Alya's older sister Nora becomes akumatized by Hawk Moth into Anansi, an enormous spider-woman hybrid named after an African folktale.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 2x18
episodes_data.description: The supervillain Sandboy uses his powers to turn the nightmares of Parisians into reality, forcing a Tikki-less Marinette to intervene.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 2x19
episodes_data.description: Angry over his perception that Marinette and Nathaniel humiliated him, fellow student Marc becomes Reverser, who is determined to get revenge.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 2x20
episodes_data.description: A figure skater gets akumatized by Hawk Moth into Frozer, a villain armed with powerful skates who tries to turn Paris into a frozen wasteland.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 2x21
episodes_data.description: When she is humiliated by Gabriel, Chloe's mother becomes Style Queen, who possesses a magical scepter and aims to exact her revenge on Adrien.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 2x22
episodes_data.description: In an attempt to impress her mother, Chloe tries to become the superhero Queen Bee but is instead transformed into the supervillain Queen Wasp.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 2x23
episodes_data.description: When Chloe considers leaving Paris, her father, Mayor Bourgeois, turns into Malediktator, a powerful villain who wants her to stay at any cost.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 2x24
episodes_data.description: Marinette lies about preparing a good deed to perform for others on the Day of Heroes and quickly finds her untruth spinning out of control.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 2x25
episodes_data.description: Ladybug and Cat Noir face one of their most fearsome opponents when Hawk Moth sets a sinister plan into motion by akumatizing his assistant.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 2x26
Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 3x1
episodes_data.description: After Marinette mixes up some messages, an old love of Master Fu becomes Backwarder, who wields a magic wand that can steal time from others.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 3x2
episodes_data.description: Disappointed that Cat Noir doesn't return his daughter's love, Tom becomes Weredad, who locks Marinette in a magic prison to protect her from hurt.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 3x3
episodes_data.description: Marinette and Adrien confront Lila with her lies, so she asks Hawk Moth to akumatize her into Chameleon, a new villain determined to destroy Ladybug.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 3x4
episodes_data.description: Humiliated at the premiere of his new Ladybug and Cat Noir movie, the director becomes Animaestro, forcing the real superheroes to act fast.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 3x5
episodes_data.description: Marinette meets her grumpy grandpa for the first time, leading him to akumatize into a villain who wants to destroy everything modern in Paris.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 3x6
episodes_data.description: Marinette and Kitty Section record a music video, but an unscrupulous producer, the father of XY, steals their ideas and inspires Luka to seek revenge.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 3x7
episodes_data.description: When they enter the Montparnasse Tower, Ladybug and Cat Noir lose their memories and transform back into Marinette and Adrien in front of each other.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 3x8
episodes_data.description: Ladybug and Cat Noir must fight Aurore Boreale when she is akumatized again into Stormy Weather 2, who wants to plunge the world into endless winter.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 3x9
episodes_data.description: Ladybug and Cat Noir each get the other's Miraculous when they must take on Juleka, who has become Reflekta again and now has a sentimonster.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 3x10
episodes_data.description: Kagami becomes jealous when Lila manipulates her way into the Agreste mansion and turns into Oni-Chan, a masked villain who can teleport.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 3x11
episodes_data.description: Sabrina, angry at Chloe for the attention she gives to Ladybug, becomes Miraculer, who can steal powers away from superheroes.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 3x12
episodes_data.description: Marinette tries to arrange some alone time with Adrien at the wax museum, but she's supposed to be babysitting Manon, who becomes Puppeteer again.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 3x13
episodes_data.description: Jagged Stone seeks to replace the guitarist he fired, who akumatizes into Desperada, a villain with a magic guitar that turns people into stickers.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 3x14
episodes_data.description: Anxiously awaiting news about her astronaut application, Max's mom becomes Startrain, who wants to turn her train into a rocket ship.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 3x15
episodes_data.description: Mrs. Mendeleiev discovers Plagg and Tikki and plans to reveal the existence of the kwamis on a TV show until she is akumatized into Kwami Buster.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 3x16
episodes_data.description: A strange statue uncovered in Tibet turns out to be a sentimonster called Feast that was created accidentally by Master Fu when he was a child.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 3x17
episodes_data.description: Adrien is the prize in a Paris-wide Friendship Day treasure hunt, but Marinette is teamed up with Kagami, who has disobeyed her mother to participate.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 3x18
episodes_data.description: Ladybug and Cat Noir are trapped between two time travelers from the future, one of whom has been sent by Hawk Moth to steal their Miraculous.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 3x19
episodes_data.description: After Adrien tells his friend Wayem he's not allowed to have friends over, Wayem discovers an impromptu party at the Agrestes that makes him jealous.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 3x20
episodes_data.description: When he can't find anyone to test his video game that pits formerly akumatized villains against one another, Max again becomes one himself: Gamer 2.0.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 3x21
episodes_data.description: Marinette uses her powers to leave a gift for Adrien, causing him to realize her secret identity -- which has a devastating impact on the future.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 3x22
episodes_data.description: Marinette reveals her feelings for Adrien on the anniversary of his mom's death, but his lookalike cousin pretends to be Adrien and responds cruelly.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 3x23
episodes_data.description: Marinette's scheming nemesis Lila manipulates all of her friends into turning against her and even gets Marinette expelled from school.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 3x24
episodes_data.description: Marinette babysits Nino's little brother, Chris, who akumatizes into Chris Master and wields a magic snow globe that can make giant toys.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 3x25
episodes_data.description: At a celebration for their twentieth anniversary, the Bourgeois couple is akumatized into Hearthunter, a two-headed Cerberus that devours love.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 3x26
episodes_data.description: Hawk Moth changes Chloe into Miracle Queen and conquers Paris, forcing Miraculous wearers to reveal themselves -- but Ladybug and Cat Noir escape.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 4x1
episodes_data.description: A friend of Marinette's gets akumatized into Truth. Using his power to force people to tell the truth, he wants to know Marinette's secret.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 4x2
episodes_data.description: A friend of Adrien's gets akumatized into Lies and becomes determined to rid the world of lies and those who tell them.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 4x3
episodes_data.description: Marinette's friends get akumatized into the Gang of Secrets, a team of supervillains determined to save her.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 4x4
episodes_data.description: Mr. Ramier gets akumatized into Mr. Pigeon for the 72nd time, and now he can turn people into evil pigeons.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 4x5
episodes_data.description: Ladybug and Cat Noir face someone they know well, and never imagined they would have to fight someday.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 4x6
episodes_data.description: A newcomer to Marinette's circle of friends gets akumatized into Sole Crusher, a humongous supervillain who can absorb people.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 4x7
episodes_data.description: Chloe is akumatized into Queen Banana and Ladybug decides to entrust a Miraculous to help her stop a supervillain.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 4x8
episodes_data.description: When Reflekta becomes entangled in a bottomless abyss of guilt, Ladybug calls an ally for help with unshakable optimism.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 4x9
episodes_data.description: Because of a plan thought up by Marinette, Shadow Moth akumatizes two villains. Ladybug and Cat Noir will need help to stop the evil duo.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 4x10
episodes_data.description: What would happen if Shadow Moth created a fearsome supervillain while Marinette and Adrien couldn't transform into Ladybug and Cat Noir?

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 4x11
episodes_data.description: Shadow Moth creates Sentibubbler, a fearsome sentimonster that will only stop if Rena Rouge betrays Ladybug and Cat Noir!

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 4x12
episodes_data.description: As Guardian of Miraculous, Ladybug must make difficult decisions which affect the people around her. But not everyone is ready to live in permanent hiding like her...

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 4x13
episodes_data.description: When Malediktator comes back, now seconded by a Sentimonster, Ladybug entrusts a committed friend and ally with a Miraculous to help her save Paris.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 4x14
episodes_data.description: As Marinette thinks about her future, a supervillain shows up in Paris. Able to force people to live their childhood dreams, he turns into a nightmare for our heroes.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 4x15
episodes_data.description: When Marinette needs to leave Paris for a day for her aunt's birthday in London, the fear of something happening in Ladybug's absence makes her super nervous. Shadow Moth manages to infect Max's robot with an evil virus to akumatize it again. What will happen?

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 4x16
episodes_data.description: Adrien asks Marinette a favor, who can't say no and ends up leaving her grandfather taking care of the 4 children she was taking care of to help Adrien. What she doesn't realize is that it ends up making her grandfather the Shadow Moth's next target.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 4x17
episodes_data.description: Ladybug and Cat Noir face Glaciator again. Glaciator annoys Ladybug by insisting that the superheroes are in love. Cat Noir encounters Marinette, who wrestles with secret romance.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 4x18
episodes_data.description: Galette Day is eventful for Marinette! Tikki is acting very strange and three supervillains show up! Will Ladybug still manage to establish herself as queen of the day?

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 4x19
episodes_data.description: Ladybug decides whether she should reveal Cat Noir's identity so that she can remain the Guardian.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 4x20
episodes_data.description: Marinette sneaks into the Agreste home during a private dinner, only to find that a supervillain is also crashing the party.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 4x21
episodes_data.description: A famous comedian gets akumatized into Psycomedian; able to impose any emotions on anyone, he wants to wipe the smiles off everyone's faces starting with Ladybug and Cat Noir.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 4x22
episodes_data.description: Ladybug manages to assemble an amazing team of superheroes now that she is Guardian of the Miraculous, but Cat Noir is feeling left out and decides to give up his Miraculous. Ladybug now needs to deliver the Cat Miraculous to someone else.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 4x23
episodes_data.description: When one of Shadow Moth's favorite victims is akumatized into Penalteam, a fearsome team of supervillains, Ladybug calls on her own superhero team in order to face her; may the best team win.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 4x24
episodes_data.description: Because one of Marinette's careless mistakes, one of her closet relatives is akumatized into Qilin, a fearsome supervillain.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 4x25
episodes_data.description: Without Ladybug and Cat Noir knowing, Shadow Moth patiently sets his final attack in motion...

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir 4x26
episodes_data.description: Shadow Moth's trap closes in on Ladybug and Cat Noir, threatening to turn their fate upside down forever...

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir Season 5 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: After having access to almost all the Miraculouses, Hawk Moth turns into Monarch and uses the Rabbit Miraculous to return to a vulnerable moment in Ladybug and Cat Noir's past to capture their Miraculous.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir Season 5 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: As the days go by, not a single akumatized villain shows up to torment Paris. Could Monarch possibly have given up?

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir Season 5 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: What if Ladybug's worst nightmare came true? What if Monarch showed up at Marinette Dupain-Cheng's home... would she be able to escape him?

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir Season 5 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Monarch entrusts an akumatized villain with the power of Jubilation, which shows people their deepest desires. Will Ladybug and Cat Noir escape that dangerous power?

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir Season 5 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: While Marinette and Adrien wonder about their feelings, Ladybug and Cat Noir face a villain... and her 17 goons!

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir Season 5 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: As everything turns upside down in their love lives, Ladybug and Cat Noir must exchange their Miraculous to escape a ruthless villain.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir Season 5 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: While visiting the Louvre museum, Marinette discovers the secrets of the kwagatama that Tikki gave her on her birthday.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir Season 5 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: A secret network at school is determined to find out how Monarch's new power works by deliberately triggering an akumatization. Would Ladybug and Cat Noir agree with such a plan?

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir Season 5 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: As Ladybug and Cat Noir face Glaciator again, our heroes don’t know that they are about to make a chilling discovery!

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir Season 5 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Tikki and Plagg are sad to see their carriers so sad to be forced to give up their feelings. The Kwamis will then make a radical choice that will change many things in Paris.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir Season 5 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Monarch is faced with a unique opportunity that he refuses to miss. The world is about to be reconfigured, and no one seems able to prevent it, for the Kwamis have made a choice that completely freed Marinette and Adrien from their responsibilities. For better… and for worse.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir Season 5 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: The whole class has decided to do everything to help Marinette finally get closer to Adrien, but what they don't know is that she also has come up with a unique plan to try and tell Adrien how she feels.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir Season 5 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: As the son of a celebrity, Luka piques special interest in Bob Roth, who would do anything to make money! But Luka himself would do anything to defend his values and his friends.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir Season 5 Episode 14
episodes_data.description: Marinette is about to have a normal date with Adrien, but she starts to suffer repeated panic attacks creating an emotional situation that can make her a target for Monarch.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir Season 5 Episode 15
episodes_data.description: Monarch senses a unique occasion to get a real second chance. He is ready to do anything, even if it means that this could be his last chance to seize the Miraculous.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir Season 5 Episode 16
episodes_data.description: While the gang concocts yet another elaborate plan to reunite Marinette and Adrien, Lila uses her talents for manipulation to persuade Kagami that Marinette is a liar.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir Season 5 Episode 17
episodes_data.description: Marinette learns that Zoé is secretly in love with someone in ninth grade at school. Zoé says that she cannot talk about it. To Marinette, this can only mean one thing: Zoé is in love with Adrien!

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir Season 5 Episode 18
episodes_data.description: Adrien must attend the Diamonds’ Dance organized by his father and Mrs. Tsurugi. When she finds out that Adrien did not dare to tell her about the dance, Marinette decides to go too.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir Season 5 Episode 19
episodes_data.description: Marinette decides to have a frank talk with Gabriel Agreste about her love for Adrien, and her courage inspires her friend Kagami as she tries to open up to her mother.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir Season 5 Episode 20
episodes_data.description: Marinette and Adrien’s closeness pushes the boy’s father to make Kagami the face of the brand, which infuriates Lila. She uses the class accident to call for a new election so that she can replace Marinette as class representative.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir Season 5 Episode 21
episodes_data.description: The end of secondary school is approaching and Lila & Chloé have to defend their classmates futures in front of the class council. Marinette is worried. What will be the next evil plan of the 2 villains?

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir Season 5 Episode 22
episodes_data.description: The end of the school year is approaching and the rebellion is growing. Monarch decides to implement a dangerous plan for his secret identity, but also very precarious for Ladybug and Cat Noir.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir Season 5 Episode 23
episodes_data.description: Chloé is more powerful than ever and, thanks to her, so is Monarch. Ladybug and Cat Noir wonder about their superpowers, unaware that they have just fallen into a machiavellian trap. As for Marinette and Adrien, their lives are about to change forever.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir Season 5 Episode 24
episodes_data.description: When Adrien disobeys his father to join Marinette, the latter is forced to find his son. At the same time, Marinette is convinced that Adrien is looking for her. Thinking she will find the boy she loves, she discovers a secret that nothing prepared her for.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir Season 5 Episode 25
episodes_data.description: Monarch has just placed the final pieces of his machiavellian plan on his chessboard of evil. Are Ladybug and Chat Noir doomed?

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir Season 5 Episode 26
episodes_data.description: Monarch's ultimate plan is now underway. Nothing seems to be able to stop him. Especially as, while the world is plunged into chaos, the super-villain has just trapped Ladybug himself.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir Season 5 Episode 27
